representative_text: For a patient with a penile cancer (2cm lesion on glans), please plan an interstitial HDR brachytherapy treatment. Using 6 needles in a single plane, plan 3 fractions of 6 Gy each. The plan must maintain the urethral dose below the prescription dose and cover the visible tumor with at least 95% of the prescription isodose.
